test_cases.title: İstemci başına dakikada 600 istek sınırının uygulanması
test_cases.preconditions: Ağ geçidi çalışmaktadır ve test istemcisi için rate limit yapılandırması etkinleştirilmiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Tek bir istemci kimliği ile 600 adet HTTP isteği.
test_cases.assumptions: İsteklerin tamamı aynı dakika penceresi içinde gönderilecektir.

steps.action: Test istemcisinden 600 adet HTTP isteği gönderilir.
steps.expected: Tüm istekler HTTP 200 (veya ilgili başarılı durum kodu) ile yanıtlanır.

test_cases.title: İstek sınırının aşılması durumunda HTTP 429 yanıtı
test_cases.preconditions: Ağ geçidi çalışmaktadır ve test istemcisi için rate limit yapılandırması etkinleştirilmiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Tek bir istemci kimliği ile 601 adet HTTP isteği.
test_cases.assumptions: İlk 600 istek başarılı yanıt alır, 601. istek sınırın aşıldığını tetikler.

steps.action: Test istemcisinden 600 adet HTTP isteği gönderilir.
steps.expected: İlk 600 istek başarılı yanıt alır.

steps.action: Aynı istemciden 601. HTTP isteği gönderilir.
steps.expected: İstek HTTP 429 durum kodu ile reddedilir.

test_cases.title: Sınır aşımında Retry-After başlığının varlığı
test_cases.preconditions: Ağ geçidi çalışmaktadır ve test istemcisi için rate limit yapılandırması etkinleştirilmiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Tek bir istemci kimliği ile 601 adet HTTP isteği.
test_cases.assumptions: Retry-After başlığının değeri pozitif bir tam sayı olarak döner.

steps.action: Test istemcisinden 601. HTTP isteği gönderilir (ilk 600 istek zaten gönderilmiş ve sınır aşılmış durumdadır).
steps.expected: Yanıt HTTP 429 durum kodu içerir.

steps.action: HTTP 429 yanıtının başlıkları incelenir.
steps.expected: Yanıt başlıklarında 'Retry-After' alanı mevcuttur ve geçerli bir değer taşır.

test_cases.title: 2000 istek/saniye yük altında 99. persentil gecikme sınırı
test_cases.preconditions: Ağ geçidi ve arka uç servisler çalışmaktadır. Yük test aracı yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: 2000 istek/saniye hızında sürekli HTTP istek akışı.
test_cases.assumptions: Test süresi, 99. persentil istatistiğinin güvenilir şekilde hesaplanabilmesi için yeterli uzunluktadır (ör. 5 dakika).

steps.action: Ağ geçidine 2000 istek/saniye hızında yük uygulanır.
steps.expected: Sistem istekleri işler ve yanıt verir.

steps.action: Test süresince kaydedilen gecikme (latency) verileri analiz edilir.
steps.expected: 99. persentil gecikme değeri 20 ms veya daha azdır.

test_cases.title: Arka uç zaman aşımında HTTP 504 yanıtı
test_cases.preconditions: Ağ geçidi çalışmaktadır. Arka uç servisi, istekleri 5 saniyeden uzun süre bekletecek şekilde yapılandırılmıştır veya simüle edilmiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Arka uç servisine yönlendirilen tek bir HTTP isteği.
test_cases.assumptions: Arka uç servisi 5 saniyeden uzun bir süre yanıt vermemektedir.

steps.action: Ağ geçidinden arka uç servisine bir HTTP isteği gönderilir.
steps.expected: İstek 5 saniye boyunca bekletilir.

steps.action: 5 saniye dolunca ağ geçidinin davranışı gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: Ağ geçidi isteği sonlandırır ve istemciye HTTP 504 durum kodu döner.

test_cases.title: Configuration change applied without restart
test_cases.preconditions: Gateway is running and active.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid configuration change (e.g., updating a rate limit value).
test_cases.assumptions: The configuration management interface allows dynamic updates.

steps.action: Apply a configuration change to the running gateway.
steps.expected: The configuration change is accepted and the gateway does not restart.

steps.action: Verify the gateway process status.
steps.expected: The gateway process remains active with the same PID, indicating no restart occurred.

test_cases.title: In-flight requests preserved during configuration change
test_cases.preconditions: Gateway is running and active.
test_cases.test_inputs: A long-running request (e.g., a request with a 5-second delay) and a configuration change.
test_cases.assumptions: A test endpoint exists that can simulate a long-running request.

steps.action: Initiate a long-running request to the gateway.
steps.expected: The request is accepted and processing begins.

steps.action: Apply a configuration change while the request is in-flight.
steps.expected: The configuration change is applied without interrupting the in-flight request.

steps.action: Wait for the in-flight request to complete.
steps.expected: The request completes successfully with the expected response, indicating it was not dropped.

test_cases.title: Logging of request metadata
test_cases.preconditions: Gateway is running and logging is enabled.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid API request with a known client ID and endpoint.
test_cases.assumptions: The logging configuration specifies a log file location and format.

steps.action: Send a valid API request to the gateway.
steps.expected: The request is processed and a response is returned.

steps.action: Inspect the configured log file for the request entry.
steps.expected: The log entry contains the trace ID, client ID, endpoint, response code, and duration information.

test_cases.title: Logging of error response metadata
test_cases.preconditions: Gateway is running and logging is enabled.
test_cases.test_inputs: An invalid API request (e.g., missing required header).
test_cases.assumptions: The gateway returns a 400 Bad Request for invalid requests.

steps.action: Send an invalid API request to the gateway.
steps.expected: The request is rejected with a 400 Bad Request response.

steps.action: Inspect the configured log file for the request entry.
steps.expected: The log entry contains the trace ID, client ID, endpoint, response code (400), and duration information.

test_cases.title: Classification of a document with high confidence
test_cases.preconditions: The service is running and accessible.
test_cases.test_inputs: A document clearly belonging to one of the 12 categories (e.g., 'Invoice').

steps.action: Submit the document to the classification service.
steps.expected: The service returns a classification result.

steps.action: Inspect the returned category.
steps.expected: The category is one of the 12 defined categories and matches the expected category ('Invoice').

steps.action: Inspect the returned confidence score.
steps.expected: The confidence score is a number between 0 and 1 (inclusive).

test_cases.title: Routing of a document with low confidence to human review
test_cases.preconditions: The service is running and accessible.
test_cases.test_inputs: A document designed to yield a confidence score below 0.60 (e.g., ambiguous or mixed content).
test_cases.assumptions: The document is crafted to produce a confidence score < 0.60 based on prior testing or model behavior.

steps.action: Submit the document to the classification service.
steps.expected: The service returns a response indicating the document was routed to the human review queue.

steps.action: Check the human review queue.
steps.expected: The document appears in the human review queue and is not marked as automatically classified.

test_cases.title: Boundary case: Document with confidence score exactly 0.60
test_cases.preconditions: The service is running and accessible.
test_cases.test_inputs: A document designed to yield a confidence score of exactly 0.60.
test_cases.assumptions: The document is crafted to produce a confidence score of exactly 0.60.

steps.action: Submit the document to the classification service.
steps.expected: The service returns a classification result with a confidence score of 0.60.

steps.action: Check the routing status of the document.
steps.expected: The document is classified automatically and is NOT routed to the human review queue.

test_cases.title: Boundary case: Document with confidence score just below 0.60
test_cases.preconditions: The service is running and accessible.
test_cases.test_inputs: A document designed to yield a confidence score of 0.59.
test_cases.assumptions: The document is crafted to produce a confidence score of 0.59.

steps.action: Submit the document to the classification service.
steps.expected: The service returns a response indicating the document was routed to the human review queue.

steps.action: Check the human review queue.
steps.expected: The document appears in the human review queue.

test_cases.title: Verification of top three contributing text passages
test_cases.preconditions: The service is running and accessible.
test_cases.test_inputs: A document with distinct, identifiable text segments.

steps.action: Submit the document to the classification service.
steps.expected: The service returns a classification result.

steps.action: Inspect the response for contributing text passages.
steps.expected: The response includes exactly three text passages.

steps.action: Verify that the passages are substrings of the original document.
steps.expected: Each of the three passages is a verbatim substring of the submitted document.

test_cases.title: Error handling: Submission of an empty document
test_cases.preconditions: The service is running and accessible.
test_cases.test_inputs: An empty document (0 bytes or empty string).

steps.action: Submit the empty document to the classification service.
steps.expected: The service returns an error response indicating invalid input.

steps.action: Verify that no classification result is returned.
steps.expected: No category or confidence score is provided in the response.

test_cases.title: Macro-averaged F1 score verification on held-out set
test_cases.preconditions: The classification model is trained and ready for evaluation. A held-out evaluation dataset is available and accessible.
test_cases.test_inputs: Held-out evaluation dataset containing labeled documents.
test_cases.assumptions: The evaluation script correctly calculates the macro-averaged F1 score.

steps.action: Run the evaluation process on the held-out evaluation set using the trained model.
steps.expected: The system completes the evaluation without errors.

steps.action: Retrieve the calculated macro-averaged F1 score from the evaluation results.
steps.expected: The reported macro-averaged F1 score is at least 0.90.

test_cases.title: Recall parity between Turkish and English documents
test_cases.preconditions: The classification model is trained and ready for evaluation. A held-out evaluation dataset containing both Turkish and English documents is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: Held-out evaluation dataset with labeled Turkish and English documents.
test_cases.assumptions: The evaluation script can filter results by language and calculate recall per language.

steps.action: Run the evaluation process on the held-out evaluation set using the trained model.
steps.expected: The system completes the evaluation without errors.

steps.action: Calculate the recall score for documents written in Turkish.
steps.expected: A valid recall score for Turkish documents is obtained.

steps.action: Calculate the recall score for documents written in English.
steps.expected: A valid recall score for English documents is obtained.

steps.action: Calculate the absolute difference between the Turkish and English recall scores in percentage points.
steps.expected: The difference is less than or equal to 5 percentage points.

test_cases.title: Response time under 50 req/s load
test_cases.preconditions: The service is deployed and operational. A load testing tool is configured to send 50 requests per second.
test_cases.test_inputs: A set of valid document inputs sufficient to generate at least 100 requests (to ensure statistical significance for the 95th percentile).
test_cases.assumptions: The load generator can accurately measure and log the response time for each individual request.

steps.action: Start the load test sending 50 requests per second to the classification service.
steps.expected: The service accepts all requests without connection errors or timeouts.

steps.action: Run the load test for a sufficient duration to collect at least 100 response time samples.
steps.expected: The load test completes and logs the response time for each request.

steps.action: Calculate the 95th percentile of the recorded response times.
steps.expected: The calculated 95th percentile response time is less than or equal to 500 ms.

test_cases.title: Logging of model version, input hash, and predicted category
test_cases.preconditions: The service is running and the logging mechanism is accessible (e.g., via log files or database).
test_cases.test_inputs: A single valid document input with known content.
test_cases.assumptions: The current model version is known and can be identified in the logs. The input hash algorithm is deterministic and known.

steps.action: Send a valid document to the classification service.
steps.expected: The service returns a successful classification result.

steps.action: Retrieve the log entry corresponding to the request.
steps.expected: The log entry contains a field for the model version, a field for the input hash, and a field for the predicted category.

steps.action: Verify the values in the log entry.
steps.expected: The model version matches the currently deployed version, the input hash matches the calculated hash of the input document, and the predicted category matches the result returned by the service.

test_cases.title: Alert triggered when PSI exceeds 0.2
test_cases.preconditions: The service is running. A baseline distribution for predicted categories is established. The alerting mechanism is monitored.
test_cases.test_inputs: A set of documents engineered to produce a predicted category distribution that deviates significantly from the baseline, resulting in a Population Stability Index (PSI) > 0.2.
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows for the injection of test data or the simulation of a weekly aggregation period to trigger the PSI calculation. The alert channel (e.g., email, dashboard) is accessible for verification.

steps.action: Process a batch of documents that results in a weekly predicted category distribution with a PSI > 0.2 compared to the baseline.
steps.expected: The service processes the documents and updates the weekly distribution statistics.

steps.action: Wait for the PSI calculation and alert evaluation cycle to complete.
steps.expected: An alert is raised indicating that the PSI threshold has been exceeded.

steps.action: Inspect the alert details.
steps.expected: The alert message contains information about the deviation, specifically referencing the PSI value or the threshold breach.

test_cases.title: No alert triggered when PSI is below 0.2
test_cases.preconditions: The service is running. A baseline distribution for predicted categories is established. The alerting mechanism is monitored.
test_cases.test_inputs: A set of documents that produce a predicted category distribution similar to the baseline, resulting in a Population Stability Index (PSI) <= 0.2.
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows for the injection of test data or the simulation of a weekly aggregation period to trigger the PSI calculation.

steps.action: Process a batch of documents that results in a weekly predicted category distribution with a PSI <= 0.2 compared to the baseline.
steps.expected: The service processes the documents and updates the weekly distribution statistics.

steps.action: Wait for the PSI calculation and alert evaluation cycle to complete.
steps.expected: No alert is raised regarding the PSI threshold.

test_cases.title: Create casualty record with valid data

test_cases.test_inputs: Identifier: CAS-001, Category: Immediate, Description: Gunshot wound to leg, Time: 10:00

steps.action: Navigate to the 'New Casualty' screen.
steps.expected: The form for creating a casualty record is displayed.

steps.action: Enter 'CAS-001' in the identifier field.
steps.expected: The identifier field displays 'CAS-001'.

steps.action: Select 'Immediate' from the triage category dropdown.
steps.expected: The triage category field displays 'Immediate'.

steps.action: Enter 'Gunshot wound to leg' in the injury description field.
steps.expected: The description field displays 'Gunshot wound to leg'.

steps.action: Set the time of injury to '10:00'.
steps.expected: The time field displays '10:00'.

steps.action: Tap the 'Save' button.
steps.expected: A success message is displayed and the new casualty record appears in the list.

test_cases.title: Verify distinct colors for triage categories
test_cases.preconditions: Application is open and user is logged in as a medic.
test_cases.assumptions: The configuration defines distinct colors for Immediate, Delayed, Minimal, and Expectant categories.

steps.action: Create a casualty record with triage category 'Immediate'.
steps.expected: The record is saved and displayed with the color assigned to 'Immediate' in the configuration.

steps.action: Create a casualty record with triage category 'Delayed'.
steps.expected: The record is saved and displayed with the color assigned to 'Delayed' in the configuration, which is different from 'Immediate'.

steps.action: Create a casualty record with triage category 'Minimal'.
steps.expected: The record is saved and displayed with the color assigned to 'Minimal' in the configuration, which is different from 'Immediate' and 'Delayed'.

steps.action: Create a casualty record with triage category 'Expectant'.
steps.expected: The record is saved and displayed with the color assigned to 'Expectant' in the configuration, which is different from the other three categories.

test_cases.title: Record valid vital signs with timestamp
test_cases.preconditions: A casualty record exists. The configuration defines plausible ranges for vital signs.
test_cases.test_inputs: Heart Rate: 80, Respiratory Rate: 16, Blood Pressure: 120/80, SpO2: 98
test_cases.assumptions: The current system time is 12:00:00.

steps.action: Open the existing casualty record and navigate to the vital signs section.
steps.expected: The vital signs input form is displayed.

steps.action: Enter 80 for heart rate, 16 for respiratory rate, 120/80 for blood pressure, and 98 for SpO2.
steps.expected: The values are accepted and displayed in the input fields.

steps.action: Tap the 'Save' button for vital signs.
steps.expected: The vital signs are saved with a timestamp of 12:00:00 and are displayed in the record history.

test_cases.title: Reject vital signs outside plausible ranges
test_cases.preconditions: A casualty record exists. The configuration defines plausible ranges for vital signs (e.g., Heart Rate 30-220).
test_cases.test_inputs: Heart Rate: 300, Respiratory Rate: 16, Blood Pressure: 120/80, SpO2: 98
test_cases.assumptions: The maximum plausible heart rate in configuration is 220.

steps.action: Open the existing casualty record and navigate to the vital signs section.
steps.expected: The vital signs input form is displayed.

steps.action: Enter 300 for heart rate, 16 for respiratory rate, 120/80 for blood pressure, and 98 for SpO2.
steps.expected: The input field for heart rate may display an error indicator or the value is highlighted as invalid.

steps.action: Tap the 'Save' button for vital signs.
steps.expected: The system rejects the input, displays an error message indicating the value is outside the plausible range, and the vital signs are not saved.

test_cases.title: Offline functionality and local storage capacity
test_cases.preconditions: The application is installed on the tablet. The device is in airplane mode or has no network connection. The local database is empty.
test_cases.test_inputs: 500 unique casualty record data sets.
test_cases.assumptions: The tablet has sufficient battery and storage space. The 'casualty record' structure is defined in the application schema.

steps.action: Verify that the application launches and the main interface is accessible without network connectivity.
steps.expected: The application loads successfully and displays the main interface without network error messages.

steps.action: Create 500 distinct casualty records using the application's data entry forms.
steps.expected: All 500 records are successfully saved to the local storage without errors or data loss.

steps.action: Attempt to view, edit, and delete a sample of the created records while offline.
steps.expected: The application allows viewing, editing, and deleting records locally without requiring network access.

test_cases.title: Synchronization upon connectivity restoration
test_cases.preconditions: The application is offline with 10 local casualty records that have not been synced. The server is accessible and contains no conflicting records for these IDs.
test_cases.test_inputs: 10 local casualty records.
test_cases.assumptions: The server is running and reachable. The synchronization mechanism is triggered automatically upon network detection.

steps.action: Restore network connectivity to the tablet.
steps.expected: The application detects the connection and initiates the synchronization process.

steps.action: Wait for the synchronization process to complete.
steps.expected: The 10 local records are successfully transmitted to the server and marked as synced in the local application.

steps.action: Verify the records on the server side.
steps.expected: The server contains the 10 records with data matching the local versions.

test_cases.title: Conflict resolution by keeping both versions
test_cases.preconditions: A casualty record with ID 'C-100' exists on the server with status 'Stable'. The same record ID 'C-100' exists locally with status 'Critical' (modified while offline).
test_cases.test_inputs: Local record C-100 (Status: Critical), Server record C-100 (Status: Stable).
test_cases.assumptions: The application identifies conflicts based on record ID and modification timestamp or version number.

steps.action: Restore network connectivity to trigger synchronization.
steps.expected: The application detects a conflict for record ID 'C-100'.

steps.action: Observe the application's behavior regarding the conflicting record.
steps.expected: The application does not overwrite either version. Both the local version (Critical) and the server version (Stable) are preserved.

steps.action: Check the application's interface for the conflicting record.
steps.expected: The record is flagged or listed in a 'Manual Review' or 'Conflicts' section, allowing the user to see both versions.

test_cases.title: Casualty data encryption verification
test_cases.preconditions: The application is installed and running on the tablet. A test casualty record has been created and saved.
test_cases.test_inputs: A sample casualty record with unique identifiers (e.g., Name: 'Test Patient', ID: '12345').
test_cases.assumptions: Access to the device's file system or storage dump is available for inspection.

steps.action: Create and save a new casualty record in the application.
steps.expected: The record is successfully saved and visible in the application interface.

steps.action: Access the underlying storage file or database where the casualty data is persisted.
steps.expected: The raw data is not readable as plain text; it appears as encrypted binary data.

steps.action: Verify the encryption algorithm used for the stored data using a forensic tool or configuration check.
steps.expected: The encryption method is confirmed to be AES-256.

test_cases.title: Battery life under defined usage profile
test_cases.preconditions: The tablet is fully charged (100%). The 'defined usage profile' is documented and available (e.g., screen on, GPS active, specific app usage).

test_cases.assumptions: The 'defined usage profile' is a standardized sequence of operations (e.g., 50% screen brightness, continuous data entry, periodic network sync) that can be automated or manually replicated consistently.

steps.action: Start the tablet with a full battery and begin the defined usage profile immediately.
steps.expected: The tablet operates normally, and the battery level starts at 100%.

steps.action: Continue the defined usage profile without interruption until the battery is depleted or the device shuts down.
steps.expected: The device remains operational and responsive throughout the test period.

steps.action: Record the total elapsed time from the start of the test until the device shuts down or becomes unusable due to low battery.
steps.expected: The total elapsed time is at least 8 hours.

test_cases.title: İz güncellemesinin harita üzerinde gösterilme süresi

test_cases.title: 120 saniye güncelleme almayan izin görüntüden kaldırılması
test_cases.preconditions: Harita üzerinde 'eskimiş' olarak işaretlenmiş bir iz bulunmaktadır.

test_cases.title: Classification of a document with high confidence

test_cases.title: Response time under 50 req/s load
